metadata.normalization: average-rank percentiles 0–100 among the same complete eligible Amsterdam neighbourhoods; income reversed; ties equal
metadata.income_definition: O&S IHHINK_MED: median disposable household income, not equivalised/standardised; student households and institutional residents excluded
metadata.income_period_note: API heeftBetrekkingOp=2024; tijdType=Peildatum; begindatum=2024-01-01. Do not infer a verified tax-income reference year.
metadata.income_rounding_note: Metadata describes rounding to hundreds; API values are not all multiples of 100. Published values retained unchanged.
metadata.income_missing_note: No 2024 Wijk record in the complete indicator response. Indicator metadata suppresses areas with fewer than 100 households; absence does not prove the reason for each neighbourhood.
metadata.green_method: Amsterdam O&S 2025 ORPUBGROEN_P: public green area / total land area, joined by official Wijk code using geography 20220324. Source fraction multiplied by 100; deficit=100-share%. Private gardens and green roofs are not added. Does not measure access, distance or cooling performance
metadata.heat_method: Median of finite band-1 summer LST composite pixels with band-2 valid_count>0, within each polygon and non-water WorldCover land mask; native 30 m raster
metadata.raster_membership: pixel-centre inclusion, all_touched=False; WorldCover nearest-neighbour resampled only for thermal land mask
metadata.coverage_note: Coverage thresholds are analyst choices, not provider rules. Coverage is spatial, not household coverage.
metadata.landsat_limit: Existing project composite, JJA 2019–2023. Original scene selection/cloud-mask script is not supplied; zonal extraction is reproducible from the supplied composite.
metadata.brussels: 145 Monitoring areas; 118 ranked independently using equivalised after-tax income; income definitions differ
